cues.passage: Black space, full of stars. Far away, one star is a little brighter than the rest: the Sun.
cues.voyager: Voyager 1 drifts in the dark: a white dish as wide as a car is long, a long thin arm, a small body. Behind it, the Sun is only a bright star.
cues.dish: Night on Earth. A white antenna dish, 70 meters wide, stands as tall as a twenty-story building against the stars.
cues.aim: The same dish, seen from behind. In the sky ahead: a bright planet, a small ring where the computer predicts Voyager 1, and empty sky.
cues.listen: The great dish has turned. It points at one place in the sky and does not move.
cues.portrait: The view from Voyager 1, looking back. The Sun is a bright star. Near it, a few faint dots in a line are the planets. One of them, pale and blue, is the Earth.
cues.clew: Voyager 1 again, very small, with the Sun behind it.
cues.status: Voyager 1 from the front. Its dish points back at a star that is our Sun.
cues.file: Voyager 1 turns slowly so you can see every side.
